deploy-bot: Production rollout started for service=runtime-api env=us-west-2 tag=v3.5.0 commit=3a1b2c9 :rocket:
Leah: Copy. Initiating preflight checks now.
Priya: DB migration plan reviewed, no destructive steps. Backups done.
Sam: Observability checks green, synthetic traffic baseline OK.
Miguel: Canaries set to 10% traffic. Notifying SRE oncall @evelyn.
evelyn: Oncall ack. Watching errors, latency, and token throughput.
Leah: Pinning rollout to commit `3a1b2c9` for this cut — will block auto-migrations if failure.
deploy-bot: Canary completed: 10% -> no errors in 5m. latency_p50 change +2ms, errors 0 -> proceed to 50%.
Sam: Saw slight 5% increase in tail latency on a small subset, digging in.
Priya: Nothing in infra alerts. Could be cache warm-up. Holding at 50% for another 3m.
Miguel: Agreed hold. Scaling up replica count for canary group.
evelyn: Alert: transient spike in 95th pctl latency ~2200ms at 12:47:03. It correlated with host gpus warming.
Leah: Rollback check: any user-facing errors? Sam?
Sam: No user-facing errors, only internal queueing increased. Ops scaling should smooth.
Leah: OK proceeding with cautious ramp. Move to 100% in 2m. Tag pinned `v3.5.0-rc1`.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 100% for tag=v3.5.0 commit=3a1b2c9 :white_check_mark:
Miguel: Post-cut telemetry looks stable. p50 +3ms, p95 back to baseline.
Priya: Release notes posted: https://docs.redwood.com/release-notes/v3.5.0
Leah: Thanks everyone. Watch the dashboards for next 30m. If anything odd, call rollback.
Sam: Noted. Will keep an eye on error budget and queues.
evelyn: Oncall will stay on watch until 14:30 PT. :eyes:
